findings.text: the case test_a_dispatch_naming_no_member_commits_its_registration asserts an unnamed dispatch's member starts with session- and commits a chore(roster) registration row, the exact contract the plan's 2026-09-24 lead ruling retires; the landed change makes it fail and it lies outside this node's fence, so it needs the assertion swap the source manifest names before the section's merged-head gate.

the case test_unnamed_dispatches_are_isolated_and_reuse_their_captured_session asserts both disposable members are rows in crew.json and, at line 146, that a later dispatch reuses its private member, both retired by the same ruling; its task-keyed session assertions still hold, so the adaptation must drop the roster and member-reuse halves and keep the session half.

item_verdicts.diff: one commit against base 7e90064d, itself the pre-fenced test commit; the diff swaps the session-derived identity for the per-run one, removes the roster registration, updates the boundary-baseline comment, and adds the _live_view helper plus two disposable-prefix assertions; the commit content is byte-identical to the worker's tested change.patch (sha256 0ed5c217a4898306...).
item_verdicts.done_when: the gate's named file tests/test_no_member_dispatch_runs_alone.py is 1 failed / 1 passed at pure base 7e90064d and 2 passed at head ecd1528c in scratch trees I built myself, while the done-when's "zero added failures" clause measures unmet at 2 added ids, which the source manifest records rather than hides.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a dispatch naming no member runs under its own disposable identity instead of the one session-derived member; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3681 mints effective_member = member or _disposable_member_id(run_id), the single choke point every unnamed dispatch passes, and the _register_session_member call site is gone.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both cohort arms with counts and failure ids, the declared negative-control string with its red log, the ruff and format deltas, the read-only .git blocker and follow_ons, and it reports the unmet gate clause instead of fitting the number it was given.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared fence is reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_no_member_dispatch_runs_alone.py plus three docs paths; git show --stat ecd1528c lists exactly the three code and test files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the back-to-back case reddens when the session-derived binding is restored — the declared control's log fails with member-in-flight on session-b1d9aed7a2e9cff24be1 and my base arm reproduces the same refusal — so the guard fires, but the roster-bytes and live-home assertions are reached by no red run and the promotion row's member is unpinned, which costs two points.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's 25-file gate records both arms with failure ids and I reproduced the named file myself (reviewer-base-arm.log 1 failed / 1 passed, reviewer-head-arm.log 2 passed), but the zero-added-failures clause measures false at this head, so the evidence demonstrates the fix plus an unmet integration clause rather than a clean gate.
justifications.fit: the helper sits beside _session_member_id at reckon/crew/routing.py:1262 and mirrors its shape and docstring style, no forbidden name is introduced, lint and format deltas are zero, and the only loose end is leaving _register_session_member at routing.py:1273 test-only for callers the fence forbids editing.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every unnamed dispatch — the CLI at reckon/cli.py:1294, the reflex review at reckon/crew/recovery.py:1055 and the shadow path at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3337 — reaches the one mint at dispatch.py:3681, and my own arms show the plan's recorded refusal at base and both launches at head.
justifications.scope_discipline: the landed commit touches only the three in-fence paths and nothing else, and my recheck shows the ruff finding multiset and the format hunk bodies are unchanged between base and head.
